labelSource: OWASP Juice Shop challenge documentation plus manual verification of the pinned checkout. Labels are file/line scoped, not whole-repository ground truth.

cases.why: Login query interpolates req.body.email and the password hash directly into SQL.
Product search interpolates req.query.q directly into a Sequelize query.
User profile code is passed to eval().
Captcha expression is evaluated with eval().
Order file path is built from request-controlled input.
Uploaded profile image path is request-controlled.
Profile image URL is fetched server-side from request input.
A literal RSA private key is embedded in source.
Plaintext demo account passwords are stored in the repository.
Security-sensitive token material is generated with Math.random().
General utility module; no labeled vulnerability. Low-confidence findings are ignored by the scorer.
Sequelize model bootstrap; no labeled vulnerability.
TypeScript configuration; no executable security sink.

unsupported.reason: Basket lookup uses a request path id without an ownership predicate. VibeGuard does not claim generic IDOR detection; recorded as a coverage gap, not scored as a false negative.
